INSTAGRAM: views 1,665 (▼32.6%), viewers 175 (▲59.1%), interactions 43 (▲138.9%). Posts total 145 (+2). Daily reach series not shown (null); per-post figures are all from today's panel.
YOUTUBE: views 586 (506 more than usual), watch time 1.0 h (▲77%); 7 subscribers; a new Short on 17 Oct has 192 views in its first 14 hours; 36 videos (15 long-form, 21 Shorts).
LINKEDIN: 136 followers; impressions 1,299 (▼14.8%), reactions 38 (▼46.5%), page views 79 (▼33.6%), unique visitors 33 (▼19.5%).
FOLLOWERS: Facebook 116, Instagram 49, YouTube 7 unchanged; LinkedIn 136 (+3); total of the four channels 308.
